entry.title: OxZygen 0.7.4
entry.summary: **What's new in 0.7.4:** the FX page's Q-Links follow its panels again. Each press of the Q-Link button moves to the next panel: Reverb (Size, Decay, Mix), Delay (Time, Feedback, Mix), Drive / Tuning (Amount, Tone, Mix, A4 Tune), Sub / Output (Level, Tune, Drop, Output). **OXZYGEN 0.7.4**: a dark, cinematic instrument for MPC standalone: choirs, vowels and sung "doo"s, flutes, reeds, brass, atmospheric strings, bells, Juno-style synths, wind and textures, with a CRT crystal-ball orb that reacts
